bg: A wide 16:9 view inside a big glass greenhouse at a flower show: glass walls and a glass roof with one small roof window, long wooden tables of potted flowers and orchids along the back wall, an empty spot on a table with a name card, a rose bush against the glass wall, a wooden door with a padlock on the left, string lights.

chars.desc: an older woman orchid grower named Mrs. Ito, Japanese, light skin, short grey hair, a wide sun hat, a flowery gardening apron, rubber boots
an older man named Mr. Kerr, light skin, white hair and a neat white moustache, a tweed waistcoat over a white shirt with an orange stain on one cuff, a fresh scratch on one forearm, brown trousers
a 10 year old girl named Rosie, light brown skin, two black braids, a green volunteer t-shirt, denim overalls, holding a small watering can
an adult gardener named Mr. Dunn, dark brown skin, bald, green work overalls, a big ring of keys on his belt, gardening gloves
a 15 year old boy named Jonah, light skin, shaggy brown hair, a yellow festival staff t-shirt, cargo shorts, sneakers
clipboard gate log list hanging on a small wooden gate post
